blocks.raw: For Partners, to be notified that a Customer is fully Approved as part of the KYC/KYB process.
blocks.text: For Partners, to be notified that a Customer is fully Approved as part of the KYC/KYB process.

blocks.raw: The `CUSTOMER_STATUS` event is triggered when a Partner's customer status is updated as the customer progresses through the KYC/KYB Process.
blocks.text: The CUSTOMER_STATUS event is triggered when a Partner's customer status is updated as the customer progresses through the KYC/KYB Process.

blocks.raw: This notification type is available to all of Modulr's Partners, but not Direct Customers. It notifies you when a Customer has passed final Verification checks so that you can create Accounts.
blocks.text: This notification type is available to all of Modulr's Partners, but not Direct Customers. It notifies you when a Customer has passed final Verification checks so that you can create Accounts.

blocks.raw:
| Parameter  | Description                                                                         |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| EventId    | Unique identifier for the webhook event. This may change if the webhook is re-sent. |
| EventName  | `CUSTOMER_STATUS`                                                                   |
| EventTime  | Date and timestamp of the event. All dates and times are UTC.                       |
| Status     | Updated status of the customer either `ACTIVE` or `BLOCKED`                         |
| CustomerId | Modulr unique customer reference for the impacted customer.                         |
